title: Slit scan
description: A porcelain frame stretches into an impossible ribbon as each image column samples a different instant.
useCase: Create temporal distortion from a rigid animation while keeping the amount of time displacement explicit and controllable.
interaction: Change time spread or pause the scan.
reducedMotion: The scene clock stops at a fixed pose. The time-spread control updates the static temporal composition directly.
limitations: Each column evaluates an analytic rigid pose at its own timestamp. It does not capture camera/video history or require feedback textures. Requires WebGL 1; static SVG artwork covers unsupported or lost contexts and automatically yields when restored.
look: Thick porcelain-white rounded frame smeared into a warped, scalloped ribbon with a dark drop shadow on deep teal; a slim slider row below.
motion: A square frame rotates and drifts continuously, each screen column rendering a different instant so it stretches into a ribbon; the Time spread slider sets offsets up to 15 s.
adapt: In `fragment`, `sampleTime` adds `(uv.x-.5)*value*15.` to the clock, so `value` (slider / 100) sets the spread; the rigid pose (`angle`, offsets, `depth`) and the `box` frame are the subject to replace. Tune the `ceramic` and `background` colours; keep the context-loss handling.
